review_notes: I read the whole file. I also grepped Mathlib for uses of mulNumerator, span_range_mulNumerator_eq_top, Ideal.le_of_map_algebraMap_le and Ideal.eq_of_map_algebraMap_le. The file has two substantial proofs. One is span_range_mulNumerator_eq_top, which uses mem_span_map, clears denominators, and takes a power of a. The other is le_of_map_algebraMap_le, which does an induction to cancel powers of x. These arguments differ, so no reasoning is repeated across two proofs. eq_of_map_algebraMap_le is a thin le_antisymm wrapper that applies le_of_map_algebraMap_le twice, which the rubric treats as insufficient. The only use of the two lemmas outside the file that I found is in UFD.lean and Locally.lean, and neither repeats the proof machinery. I did not search the rest of Mathlib for duplicated clearing-denominators arguments, so some uncertainty remains there.
